item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Oversized Folding Cot
item_short_desc: The Oversized Folding Cot features heavy-duty aluminum legs and center support bars to accommodate 300 lbs of weight capacity. The emergency cot provides a comfortable night's sleep no matter where you are.
description: The Oversized Folding Cot features heavy-duty aluminum legs and center support bars to accommodate 300 lbs of weight capacity. The emergency cot provides a comfortable night's sleep no matter where you are.  When opened this foldable cot measures 80" X 32" X 18.5" and when folded is 8" X 4.5" X 39".
